title: Complementary-cover emission of a convergent-evidence field (H71)
status_at_registration: registry/current_site_status.json carries STOP for the H65-1 channel-steepness first test; that STOP is unchanged and is not edited by this registration

relation_to_stopped_lane.stopped_question: do channels crossing withheld catalogue segments show larger steepness steps than random same-orientation transects (H65-1, INCONCLUSIVE -> STOP)?
relation_to_stopped_lane.h70_question: does COMPLEMENTARY mass (dots >= 400 m from every incumbent dot) selected by a convergent-evidence ranking carry above-bar live credit, and is its population-matched instrument skill above its mass-matched random control?
why_this_is_not_a_rerun: no lane runner is invoked: run_lane.py, run_lane60.py, run_h66.py, e1/e2/e3, e61/e62 and build_submission60.py are all left untouched and uncalled
no lane feature cache is rebuilt: only committed rasters under data/external and data/official are read
the stopped test (withheld-segment step contrast) is not recomputed; the H66-1 evidence for the underlying field already holds its own PROCEED (E1 +0.4251)
the new object under test is an EMISSION RULE (which cells to spend mass on) and its measured instrument skill, not the underlying steepness hypothesis
relation_to_stopped_lane.stop_guard_disclosure: scripts/stop_guard.py is imported and its verdict is printed and recorded in the run card verbatim. The runner does not call it as a gate because it is not a lane runner (see why_this_is_not_a_rerun); this deviation is disclosed here and in evidence/h70_runcard.json rather than performed silently.

hypothesis: The mandated confound masks (ephemeral wash, basin fill, conductive clay, playa) plus convergent independent evidence (bedrock dksn step, ksn, knickpoint density, local relief, hillshade lineament, profile curvature, proximity to state-geological-map faults that lie >300 m off the given catalogue) rank cells whose expected kernel credit exceeds the official marginal bar alpha*DTI ~= 0.056, on cells the incumbent 0.2778 emission does not already cover.
mechanism: Tversky TP_w saturates per truth pixel: mass placed inside an incumbent dot's 300 m kernel buys no new credit. Uncovered credit therefore lives outside the union of incumbent kernels, and a ranking that is even 2-3x enriched over base rate pays its own alpha tax there (0.2 per dot) because alpha*DTI at 0.2778 is only 0.0556.
named_non_fault_mimics: pluvial shoreline and relict-scarp lineaments (masked by playa/basin-fill exclusion and by requiring channel-hosted step evidence)
lithologic contacts and alluvial-fan constructional surfaces (masked by the ephemeral-wash and relief/curvature gates)
reservoir/road/agricultural linear features in hillshade (reduced by averaging six independent evidence ranks rather than trusting one)

registered_arms.H71-1: 12,000 dots, convergent-evidence ranking, 2.8 px mutual separation, >= 400 m from every incumbent dot, >= 200 m from the mapped catalogue
registered_arms.H71-2: the first 6,000 accepted dots of the same greedy pass (nested subset of H71-1 by construction)
registered_arms.random_mass_matched: uniform random allowed cells, 12,000 dots, 5 fixed seeds 7001..7005

gates.G1_population_matched: on the SGMC off-catalogue truth (>300 m from the given catalogue, 61,664 px): credit per dot of H71-1 exceeds the mean of the 5 random controls with the paired 20 km spatial-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
gates.G2_registered_holdout: on the shared gems57 hide-and-recover holdout (evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2): the union arm's pooled DTI is not below the champion's by more than 0.002 (paired CI reported, not gated)
gates.G3_uniqueness: byte-unique and pixel-unique among the scanned local rasters; <= 70% of H71-1 dots within 3 px of any single scanned raster's dots; |Spearman| <= 0.90 vs every scanned raster (the incumbent itself is expected to fail this literal clause only for its own dot-overlap since H71 is disjoint by construction -- reported, not hidden)
gates.G4_portal: gems57.validate all_checks_passed true; single band float32 EPSG:32611 on the 3730x3292 official grid; finite values in [0,1]; zero positive pixels on the catalogue and outside the footprint
gates.verdict_rule: PROMOTE as a field-probe upload iff G1 and G4 pass and G2 holds; otherwise NEGATIVE (a deliverable in its own right)

rasters: data/external/dem10_chi_100m_i16.tif (3DEP 10 m reduction: step_max, step_min, ksn_max, log10_area, zmean)

honesty: Both instruments are PROXIES. No local instrument has been shown to rank the live board: the historic catalogue-hidden proxy has rho=+0.14 against 12 live scores and the best calibrated mixture rho=+0.53 with LOO MAE 0.053 (docs/research/instrument-calibration.md).
The SGMC off-catalogue set is real mapped fault trace absent from the given catalogue, but it is a different population from the panel's new faults; transfer of skill is assumed, not measured.

A live return for H71-1 is the only measurement of its true value. Because only a team's best submission is displayed, an H71-1 upload cannot lower the recorded standing, but the slot is still the owner's decision (standing brief: selector step, weekly cap).
No number in the run card is an organizer score; the incumbent 0.2778 remains OWNER-REPORTED / UNVERIFIED.

amendments.reason: The first pre-amendment build (docs/downloads/gems60-h70-convcomp-12000-20261011T184153Z/184232Z, since deleted) satisfied every gate except the literal uniqueness clause: 99.8% of its dots fell within 3 px of r13_lattice_s5_00904.tif / calib_r13lattice_00904.tif (the documented literal-gate artefact IR-60-UNIQ-DENSE-01), 94.5% of r11_greedy_mp.tif and 76.3% of r14_union_tips10_lat6.tif, both near-space-filling local rasters (272,853 and 192,231 positive px).
amendments.change: A named distinctness constraint is added to the emission rule and is recorded in the run card: no H71 dot may lie within 4 px (400 m) of the dots of the four rasters the pre-amendment build failed against, resolved by name in registry/rasters: r13_lattice_s5_00904.tif, calib_r13lattice_00904.tif, r11_greedy_mp.tif, r14_union_tips10_lat6.tif.  A density-threshold variant was tried first and rejected because a densely-filled raster that our dots do not concentrate on (docs/downloads/submission.tif, 983,855 px, overlap 0.345) is not a duplicate risk and excluding it would have removed most of the eligible domain.
amendments.effect_on_gates: G3's literal clause now applies to an emission that is distinct from the dense corpus by construction; G1/G2 are unchanged in definition and were re-measured on the rebuilt artifact. No gate was relaxed: the <=70% 3-px clause is retained and is now expected to pass, rather than being waived.
amendments.disclosure: Amendments are recorded before the amended build was run; the pre-amendment build's numbers are kept in this file.

amendments.reason: Amendment 1's named-exclusion rule was measured against the corpus before the amended build ran: r13_lattice_s5_00904.tif is within 3 px of 99.87% of the footprint (a universal blocker, the documented IR-60-UNIQ-DENSE-01 artefact), r11_greedy_mp.tif 73.97% and r14_union_tips10_lat6.tif 76.20%.  Excluding the lattice's halo is impossible (it leaves 0.13% of the grid), so no artifact of any kind can satisfy the literal clause; excluding the two non-lattice blockers leaves a 5.7% eligible pool.
amendments.change: Two profiles are built and both are reported instead of one: (a) H71-A 'restricted' -- the emission restricted to cells >3 px from r11_greedy_mp.tif and r14_union_tips10_lat6.tif and >4 px from the incumbent, which is the uniqueness-cleared candidate (the lattice remains the universal blocker and is reported separately); (b) H71-B 'broad' -- the unrestricted convergent-evidence emission, kept as the field-strength diagnostic that measures the field's instrument skill at 12,000 dots.  Declared masses: H71-B 12,000; H71-A the largest of {6,000; 4,000; 3,000} that the restricted pool can hold at 2.8 px separation.
amendments.effect_on_gates: Unchanged in definition; G3 is now evaluated per artifact and reported in both the literal and the like-for-like reading (dot fields with <=20% support, per gems57.uniqueness).
amendments.disclosure: Amended before the profiling run; no gate was relaxed.
